# BTPS.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp1,622.0 against Rp1,020.0 (expected total return 68.1%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The report says the COE is 'built' from a 7.4% sovereign yield, ERP 4.2% plus CRP 2.5% at beta 0.90, which is 13.4-14.1%, not the 11.85% the model uses (engine: (7.45% minus 1.62% default spread) + 0.90 x (4.23% + 2.46%)
- FY2026E NP of Rp1,344.5bn (+12%) on +1% total income is produced solely by a 'lower provision charge' and normalising cost of risk that is never quantified or sourced; the template carries no credit_cost input (comps sho
- The template deviation is noted, not argued, and the method card requires an explicit argument; BTPS is the only BANKS name with nim, credit_cost, cti and loan_growth all null, so the ROE cannot be decomposed into NIM x 

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
